Package org.webharvest.runtime.database

Class StandaloneConnectionPool

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.webharvest.runtime.database.StandaloneConnectionPool
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    ConnectionFactory
    public final class StandaloneConnectionPool
extends Object
implements ConnectionFactory
    Default, standalone ConnectionFactory interface implementation. It provides very simple connection pooling - Connection created once for the given driver, url and username is reused later. While this will work fine with the short-living object lifecycle (as it is in case of Scraper), it is discouraged to use StandaloneConnectionPool as an application-wide singleton having long lifecycle.

    This implementation is not thread-safe and does not provide advanced connection pooling features. It can not execute interval connection validation, does not support connection retrieval and so forth. Additionally, in case of having too long lifecycle it is vulnerable for connection timeouts. For production deployments you should certainly use another ConnectionFactory implementation.
